correctness.rationale: The two full iterates subtract exactly to Delta[r K_Delta(G(P0)+ell)-b]. For f(x)=x^2/(m^2+x^2), f' has a unique maximum at m/sqrt(3); comparison f'(t+Delta)-f'(t) changes sign once, so K_Delta is strictly unimodal. G'(P)>0 and G is unbounded for 0<b<1, hence [0,infinity) bijects with [ell,infinity). Two strict crossings are equivalent to the precise peak-versus-start inequalities; equality/tangency and ell at/after peak are not two reversals. Independent rational checks give K(0)=30/109<12/25<K(1/2)=26/41 and crossover stocks 0.20055782314646 and 0.87699149923997. The zero-load map fixes 0,3/4,4/3, the outer two attracting and inner repelling. All model hypotheses and the two-step terminal-only scope were retained.

value.rationale: The ordering of fixed total nutrient load across two years is a natural intervention variable, and the finding gives an exact criterion when the preferable terminal-stock order changes twice with starting lake condition. The bistable rational witness demonstrates this is not an artifact of a monostable toy parameter. The sharp sign structure is useful for interpreting load-timing sensitivity, without claiming optimal environmental policy.
